info.title: Walking Dead management API
info.description: Management API of the Walking Dead multi-protocol honeypot. Everything the console does is available here, so you can build your own monitors, dashboards and automations. Authenticate with an owner session cookie or a scoped API key (Authorization: Bearer). Timestamps are Unix milliseconds in UTC. JSON mutations require Content-Type application/json; browser requests are origin-checked.
